index.tsx:47-49 lockState state + lastResultRef correctly implement 2-scan consensus. First match → candidate + 350ms retry; second match → locked + optional 800ms rescan when the identity changes. Failure paths (low conf / not identified / error) all reset lastResultRef=null so a stale candidate can never latch to a new card.
